title: Closure checks carried as attributed debt
description: The shape of contracts/closure-checks.json. A debt list with no schema is a place where prose no check reads sits next to error text a check does produce, which is how a wrong reason and a wrong provenance claim both survived a first reading. Every field here is required because an entry missing one is an exemption rather than attributed debt, and scripts/sov_closure_checks.py refuses that with CLOSURE_CHECK_DEBT_UNATTRIBUTED.

refuses.description: Every code here must be implemented and driven by a fixture; the selfcheck refuses a declared code no fixture exercises. The naming rule is not expressible here because sovkernel.jsonschema resolves no propertyNames keyword; the selfcheck is what enforces it.

expression.description: Byte-identical to the expression the custody declares. The entry is keyed on the pair, so repointing a custody leaves its entry unknown rather than silently carrying cover forward.

observed.description: What running the command actually prints: its last line of stderr, with any leading interpreter path stripped, because that path differs between hosts and a host-specific string is not evidence anybody else can reproduce. A paraphrase is how a wrong reason hides; scripts/tests/test_closure_checks.py runs each command and compares.
